title: Who's throwing errors?
intro: PagerDuty fired "HighErrorRate", but the alert does not say which service. Find it.
hints: Filter http_requests_total to status=~"5.." and look at the rate.
solution: sum by (service) (rate(http_requests_total{status=~"5.."}[5m])) shows payments far above the others.
debrief: Every incident starts with 'where?'. Breaking the error rate down by service is the fastest first step.
